correctness.rationale: Exact cancellation in the zero-magnetization sector reduces every edge swap to rim energy; explicit energy differences give the forbidden words ---, ++-- and --++. Run decomposition with t double-minus runs and s blocks of singleton-minus runs yields indexed cyclic counts k/s times two composition factors, and stars-and-bars allocations of t-1 surplus plus spins give the coefficient formula. Energies differ from ground by 4J(t-1). t>=2 requires q>=6, and a constructive D S S word family yields the exponential lower bound. Independent finite energy enumeration at odd sizes 3..15 and 8-state cyclic transfer counting through size 47 agree with formula. Scope excludes non-edge exchanges and absorbing-state claims.

value.rationale: The balanced Kawasaki sector on an odd wheel is a natural frustrated Ising testbed with a conserved magnetization. The exact energy-resolved weak-minimum polynomial isolates the first genuinely excited local minimum at rim size 11 and proves exponential proliferation despite only 2n ground states. Its complete all-size classification and universal independence from spoke strength/field give a controlled comparison to the classical antiferromagnetic chain, rather than an arbitrary finite slice. The distinction from dynamically absorbing configurations is explicit.
